caption: A full cup of coffee sits in the cup holder of a car, and as the car turns sharply left the coffee sloshes up the right side of the cup and spills over the rim.

sa.check: A full cup of coffee sits in the cup holder of a car.
The car turns sharply to the left.
The coffee climbs the right side of the cup.
The coffee spills over the rim.
The cup stays in the holder rather than being held in a hand.
The turn begins first, then the climb, then the spill.

pc.expect: The coffee surface lies level while the car runs straight; it starts to tilt as the turn begins and settles level again once the car straightens.
pc.fail: The coffee sloshes while the car is driving straight; or it climbs the cup with no turn visible outside; or it keeps sloshing long after the car has straightened up.

pc.expect: The coffee rides up the side of the cup away from the direction of the turn, which on a left turn is the right side.
pc.fail: The coffee climbs the left side of the cup during a left turn; or it rises evenly all around the rim; or it lifts straight up out of the cup.

pc.expect: The coffee behaves as a liquid: the surface tilts as one connected sheet, slops over the rim and runs down the outside of the cup.
pc.fail: The coffee surface stays flat and rigid while the cup is plainly tilted; or the coffee leaves the cup as a solid lump that keeps its shape; or the spill gathers into balls that roll away.

pc.expect: What goes over the rim runs down the outside of the cup and collects in the holder or on the console below.
pc.fail: A run of coffee climbs the outside of the cup; or a drip leaves the rim and floats; or the spill gathers on top of the cup.

pc.expect: One cup stays in the holder, and coffee leaves it only by going over the rim.
pc.fail: The cup vanishes or a second one appears; or the coffee level rises while it is spilling; or coffee passes through the wall of the cup; or the cup passes through the holder.

pc.expect: The coffee's colour, the cup and the car interior stay the same.
pc.fail: The coffee changes colour; or the cup changes size or pattern; or the dashboard and holder rearrange between frames.
